check_files_match: check whether each target file matches its corresponding generated file and return errors
fix_files: fix missing or out-of-date files by copying generated files over stale targets
create_Config: create a Config object from a file list with target name, package name, and pattern
get_file_pairs: generate a list of FilePair objects mapping target files to their generated counterparts
get_missing_and_stale: identify missing and stale files by comparing target contents against generated contents
